### write src/Sales/Scripts/Script.PostDeployment.sql
/* Dane słownikowe */
:r .\Seed\Currencies.sql
:r .\Seed\OrderStatus.sql
### write src/Sales/Scripts/Seed/Currencies.sql
MERGE [dbo].[Currencies] AS t
USING (VALUES ('PLN', N'Złoty'), ('EUR', N'Euro'), ('USD', N'Dolar')) AS s ([CurrencyCode], [Name]) ON t.[CurrencyCode] = s.[CurrencyCode]
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([CurrencyCode], [Name]) VALUES (s.[CurrencyCode], s.[Name]);
### write src/Sales/Scripts/Seed/OrderStatus.sql
MERGE [sales].[OrderStatus] AS t
USING (VALUES (1, N'Nowe'), (2, N'Opłacone'), (3, N'Wysłane'), (9, N'Anulowane')) AS s ([StatusId], [Name]) ON t.[StatusId] = s.[StatusId]
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([StatusId], [Name]) VALUES (s.[StatusId], s.[Name]);

### write src/Sales/audit/Stored Procedures/usp_WriteAudit.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [audit].[usp_WriteAudit]
    @TableName SYSNAME,
    @RowKey VARCHAR (20)
AS
    INSERT INTO [audit].[ChangeLog] ([TableName], [RowKey], [ChangedAt], [ChangedBy])
    VALUES (@TableName, @RowKey, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SUSER_SNAME());
### write src/Sales/audit/Tables/ChangeLog.sql
CREATE TABLE [audit].[ChangeLog]
(
    [LogId]     BIGINT         IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [TableName] SYSNAME        NOT NULL,
    [RowKey]    VARCHAR (20)   NOT NULL,
    [ChangedAt] DATETIME2 (3)  NOT NULL,
    [ChangedBy] NVARCHAR (128) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_ChangeLog] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([LogId] ASC)
);
### write src/Sales/audit/Tables/LoginAudit.sql
CREATE TABLE [audit].[LoginAudit]
(
    [Id]        BIGINT         IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [LoginName] NVARCHAR (128) NOT NULL,
    [LoggedAt]  DATETIME2 (0)  NOT NULL
);
### write src/Sales/cat/Stored Procedures/usp_UpdatePrice.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [cat].[usp_UpdatePrice]
    @ProductId INT,
    @CurrencyCode CHAR (3),
    @Price DECIMAL (18, 2)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO [cat].[Prices] ([ProductId], [CurrencyCode], [Price], [ValidFrom])
    VALUES (@ProductId, @CurrencyCode, @Price, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));
END
### write src/Sales/cat/Tables/Categories.sql
CREATE TABLE [cat].[Categories]
(
    [CategoryId] INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [Name]       NVARCHAR (100) NOT NULL,
    [ParentId]   INT            NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Categories] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CategoryId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Categories_Parent] FOREIGN KEY ([ParentId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Categories] ([CategoryId])
);
### write src/Sales/cat/Tables/Prices.sql
CREATE TABLE [cat].[Prices]
(
    [ProductId]    INT             NOT NULL,
    [CurrencyCode] CHAR (3)        NOT NULL,
    [Price]        DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [ValidFrom]    DATE            NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Prices] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ProductId] ASC, [CurrencyCode] ASC, [ValidFrom] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Prices_Products] FOREIGN KEY ([ProductId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Products] ([ProductId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Prices_Currencies] FOREIGN KEY ([CurrencyCode]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Currencies] ([CurrencyCode])
);
### write src/Sales/cat/Tables/Products.sql
CREATE TABLE [cat].[Products]
(
    [ProductId]  INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [Sku]        VARCHAR (30)   NOT NULL,
    [Name]       NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [CategoryId] INT            NOT NULL,
    [IsActive]   BIT            NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Products] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ProductId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Products_Categories] FOREIGN KEY ([CategoryId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Categories] ([CategoryId])
);
### write src/Sales/cat/Views/vw_Catalog.sql
CREATE VIEW [cat].[vw_Catalog]
AS
SELECT p.[ProductId], p.[Sku], p.[Name], c.[Name] AS [Category], pr.[Price], pr.[CurrencyCode]
FROM [cat].[Products] AS p
INNER JOIN [cat].[Categories] AS c ON c.[CategoryId] = p.[CategoryId]
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) x.[Price], x.[CurrencyCode] FROM [cat].[Prices] AS x WHERE x.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId] ORDER BY x.[ValidFrom] DESC) AS pr
WHERE p.[IsActive] = 1;
### write src/Sales/cfg/Tables/PurgeTables.sql
CREATE TABLE [cfg].[PurgeTables]
(
    [TableName]     SYSNAME NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [RetentionDays] INT     NOT NULL
);
### write src/Sales/crm/Stored Procedures/usp_GetCustomerCrm.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [crm].[usp_GetCustomerCrm]
    @CrmId VARCHAR (18)
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(CRM, 'SELECT Id, Email, Phone, Segment FROM Contact');
END
### write src/Sales/crm/Stored Procedures/usp_SyncFromCrm.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [crm].[usp_SyncFromCrm]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    MERGE [crm].[Customers] AS t
    USING (SELECT Id, Email, Name FROM OPENQUERY(CRM_LINK, 'SELECT Id, Email, Name FROM Contact')) AS s
        ON t.[CrmId] = s.Id
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.[Email] = s.Email, t.[FullName] = s.Name
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([Email], [FullName], [CountryCode], [CrmId]) VALUES (s.Email, s.Name, 'PL', s.Id);
END
### write src/Sales/crm/Tables/Addresses.sql
CREATE TABLE [crm].[Addresses]
(
    [AddressId]  INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [CustomerId] INT            NOT NULL,
    [Street]     NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [City]       NVARCHAR (100) NOT NULL,
    [PostalCode] VARCHAR (10)   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Addresses] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([AddressId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Addresses_Customers] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [crm].[Customers] ([CustomerId])
);
### write src/Sales/crm/Tables/Consents.sql
CREATE TABLE [crm].[Consents]
(
    [CustomerId]  INT          NOT NULL,
    [ConsentType] VARCHAR (30) NOT NULL,
    [Granted]     BIT          NOT NULL,
    [ChangedAt]   DATETIME2 (0) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Consents] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CustomerId] ASC, [ConsentType] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Consents_Customers] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [crm].[Customers] ([CustomerId])
);
### write src/Sales/crm/Tables/Customers.sql
CREATE TABLE [crm].[Customers]
(
    [CustomerId]  INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [Email]       NVARCHAR (256) NOT NULL,
    [FullName]    NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [CountryCode] CHAR (2)       NOT NULL,
    [CrmId]       VARCHAR (18)   NULL,
    [CreatedAt]   DATETIME2 (0)  CONSTRAINT [DF_Customers_CreatedAt] DEFAULT (sysutcdatetime()) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Customers] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CustomerId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Customers_Countries] FOREIGN KEY ([CountryCode]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Countries] ([CountryCode])
);
### write src/Sales/crm/Views/vw_ActiveCustomers.sql
CREATE VIEW [crm].[vw_ActiveCustomers]
AS
SELECT c.[CustomerId], c.[Email], c.[FullName], co.[Name] AS [Country]
FROM [crm].[Customers] AS c
INNER JOIN [dbo].[Countries] AS co ON co.[CountryCode] = c.[CountryCode]
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [crm].[Consents] AS x WHERE x.[CustomerId] = c.[CustomerId] AND x.[Granted] = 1);
### write src/Sales/dbo/Functions/fn_FormatMoney.sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_FormatMoney] (@Amount DECIMAL (18, 2), @CurrencyCode CHAR (3))
RETURNS NVARCHAR (40)
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN FORMAT(@Amount, 'N2') + N' ' + @CurrencyCode;
END
### write src/Sales/dbo/Stored Procedures/usp_PurgeTable.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_PurgeTable]
    @TableName SYSNAME
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [cfg].[PurgeTables] WHERE [TableName] = @TableName)
        EXEC ('TRUNCATE TABLE ' + @TableName);
END

(

    [Name]        NVARCHAR (100) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Countries] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CountryCode] ASC)
);

    CONSTRAINT [PK_Currencies] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CurrencyCode] ASC)

### write src/Sales/inv/Stored Procedures/usp_ImportStock.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[usp_ImportStock]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    MERGE [inv].[StockLevels] AS t
    USING (SELECT [ProductId], [WarehouseId], [Qty] FROM [ImportDb].[dbo].[StockFeed]) AS s
        ON t.[ProductId] = s.[ProductId] AND t.[WarehouseId] = s.[WarehouseId]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.[Qty] = s.[Qty];
END
### write src/Sales/inv/Stored Procedures/usp_RecalcStock_old.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[usp_RecalcStock_old]
AS
BEGIN
    UPDATE [inv].[StockLevels] SET [Qty] = 0 WHERE [Qty] < 0;
END
### write src/Sales/inv/Stored Procedures/usp_ReserveStock.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[usp_ReserveStock]
    @OrderId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO [inv].[Reservations] ([OrderId], [ProductId], [Qty])
    SELECT i.[OrderId], i.[ProductId], i.[Quantity] FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS i WHERE i.[OrderId] = @OrderId;
    UPDATE s SET s.[Qty] = s.[Qty] - i.[Quantity]
    FROM [inv].[StockLevels] AS s
    INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS i ON i.[ProductId] = s.[ProductId]
    WHERE i.[OrderId] = @OrderId AND s.[WarehouseId] = 1;
END
### write src/Sales/inv/Tables/Reservations.sql
CREATE TABLE [inv].[Reservations]
(
    [ReservationId] INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [OrderId]       INT NOT NULL,
    [ProductId]     INT NOT NULL,
    [Qty]           INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Reservations] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ReservationId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Reservations_Orders] FOREIGN KEY ([OrderId]) REFERENCES [sales].[Orders] ([OrderId])
);
### write src/Sales/inv/Tables/StockLevels.sql
CREATE TABLE [inv].[StockLevels]
(
    [ProductId]   INT NOT NULL,
    [WarehouseId] INT NOT NULL,
    [Qty]         INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_StockLevels] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ProductId] ASC, [WarehouseId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_StockLevels_Products] FOREIGN KEY ([ProductId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Products] ([ProductId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_StockLevels_Warehouses] FOREIGN KEY ([WarehouseId]) REFERENCES [inv].[Warehouses] ([WarehouseId])
);
### write src/Sales/inv/Tables/Warehouses.sql
CREATE TABLE [inv].[Warehouses]
(
    [WarehouseId] INT           NOT NULL,
    [Name]        NVARCHAR (80) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Warehouses] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([WarehouseId] ASC)
);
### write src/Sales/sales/Functions/fn_OrderTotal.sql
CREATE FUNCTION [sales].[fn_OrderTotal] (@OrderId INT)
RETURNS DECIMAL (18, 2)
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN (SELECT SUM([LineTotal]) FROM [sales].[OrderItems] WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId);
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Sequences/OrderNumberSeq.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE [sales].[OrderNumberSeq] AS BIGINT START WITH 100000 INCREMENT BY 1;
### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_CancelOrder.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_CancelOrder]
    @OrderId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    UPDATE [sales].[Orders] SET [StatusId] = 9 WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId;
    DELETE FROM [inv].[Reservations] WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId;
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_CreateOrder.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_CreateOrder]
    @CustomerId INT,
    @Items [sales].[OrderItemList] READONLY,
    @OrderId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO [sales].[Orders] ([CustomerId], [OrderDate], [StatusId], [TotalAmount])
    VALUES (@CustomerId, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 1, 0);
    SET @OrderId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    INSERT INTO [sales].[OrderItems] ([OrderId], [LineNo], [ProductId], [Quantity], [UnitPrice])
    SELECT @OrderId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.[ProductId]), i.[ProductId], i.[Quantity], p.[Price]
    FROM @Items AS i
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) x.[Price] FROM [cat].[Prices] AS x WHERE x.[ProductId] = i.[ProductId] ORDER BY x.[ValidFrom] DESC) AS p;
    UPDATE o SET o.[TotalAmount] = [sales].[fn_OrderTotal](@OrderId)
    FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o WHERE o.[OrderId] = @OrderId;
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_GetOrderSummary.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_GetOrderSummary]
    @OrderId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT o.[OrderId], o.[OrderDate], s.[Name] AS [Status], o.[DiscountCode],
           [sales].[fn_OrderTotal](o.[OrderId]) AS [Total],
           [dbo].[fn_FormatMoney](o.[TotalAmount], 'PLN') AS [TotalText]
    FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
    INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderStatus] AS s ON s.[StatusId] = o.[StatusId]
    WHERE o.[OrderId] = @OrderId;
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/OrderItems.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[OrderItems]
(
    [OrderId]   INT             NOT NULL,
    [LineNo]    SMALLINT        NOT NULL,
    [ProductId] INT             NOT NULL,
    [Quantity]  INT             NOT NULL,
    [UnitPrice] DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [LineTotal] AS ([Quantity] * [UnitPrice]),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_OrderItems] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([OrderId] ASC, [LineNo] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_OrderItems_Orders] FOREIGN KEY ([OrderId]) REFERENCES [sales].[Orders] ([OrderId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_OrderItems_Products] FOREIGN KEY ([ProductId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Products] ([ProductId])
);
### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/OrderStatus.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[OrderStatus]
(
    [StatusId] TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    [Name]     NVARCHAR (50) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_OrderStatus] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([StatusId] ASC)
);
### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/Orders.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[Orders]
(
    [OrderId]      INT             IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [CustomerId]   INT             NOT NULL,
    [OrderDate]    DATETIME2 (0)   NOT NULL,
    [StatusId]     TINYINT         NOT NULL,
    [TotalAmount]  DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [DiscountCode] VARCHAR (20)    NULL,
    [CreatedBy]    NVARCHAR (128)  CONSTRAINT [DF_Orders_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (suser_sname()) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Orders] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([OrderId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_Customers] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [crm].[Customers] ([CustomerId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_OrderStatus] FOREIGN KEY ([StatusId]) REFERENCES [sales].[OrderStatus] ([StatusId])
);
GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Orders_CustomerId_OrderDate]
    ON [sales].[Orders]([CustomerId] ASC, [OrderDate] ASC);
### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/Shipments.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[Shipments]
(
    [ShipmentId] INT           IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [OrderId]    INT           NOT NULL,
    [Carrier]    VARCHAR (30)  NOT NULL,
    [TrackingNo] VARCHAR (50)  NULL,
    [ShippedAt]  DATETIME2 (0) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Shipments] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ShipmentId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Shipments_Orders] FOREIGN KEY ([OrderId]) REFERENCES [sales].[Orders] ([OrderId])
);
### write src/Sales/sales/Triggers/trg_Orders_Audit.sql
CREATE TRIGGER [sales].[trg_Orders_Audit] ON [sales].[Orders]
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO [audit].[ChangeLog] ([TableName], [RowKey], [ChangedAt], [ChangedBy])
    SELECT 'sales.Orders', CAST(d.[OrderId] AS VARCHAR (20)), SYSUTCDATETIME(), SUSER_SNAME()
    FROM deleted AS d;
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Types/OrderItemList.sql
CREATE TYPE [sales].[OrderItemList] AS TABLE
(
    [ProductId] INT NOT NULL,
    [Quantity]  INT NOT NULL
);
### write src/Sales/sales/Views/vw_OpenOrders.sql
CREATE VIEW [sales].[vw_OpenOrders]
AS
SELECT o.[OrderId], o.[CustomerId], o.[OrderDate], s.[Name] AS [Status]
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderStatus] AS s ON s.[StatusId] = o.[StatusId]
WHERE o.[StatusId] < 5;

### write src/DWH/arch/Stored Procedures/usp_ArchiveOrders.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [arch].[usp_ArchiveOrders]
    @Before DATE
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [$(Archive)].[dbo].[OrdersHistory] ([OrderId], [Revenue])
    SELECT [OrderId], [Revenue] FROM [fact].[FactSales] AS f
    INNER JOIN [dim].[DimDate] AS d ON d.[DateKey] = f.[DateKey] WHERE d.[Date] < @Before;
END
### write src/DWH/arch/Views/vw_OrdersHistory.sql
CREATE VIEW [arch].[vw_OrdersHistory]
AS
SELECT [OrderId], [Revenue] FROM [$(Archive)].[dbo].[OrdersHistory];
### write src/DWH/dbo/Synonyms/syn_StgOrders.sql
CREATE SYNONYM [dbo].[syn_StgOrders] FOR [$(Staging)].[stg].[stg_Orders];
### write src/DWH/dim/Stored Procedures/usp_LoadDimCustomer.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dim].[usp_LoadDimCustomer]
AS
BEGIN
    MERGE [dim].[DimCustomer] AS t
    USING (SELECT [CustomerId], [FullName], [Country] FROM [$(Staging)].[stg].[stg_Customers]) AS s ON t.[CustomerId] = s.[CustomerId]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.[FullName] = s.[FullName], t.[Country] = s.[Country]
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([CustomerId], [FullName], [Country]) VALUES (s.[CustomerId], s.[FullName], s.[Country]);
END
### write src/DWH/dim/Tables/DimCustomer.sql
CREATE TABLE [dim].[DimCustomer]
(
    [CustomerKey] INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [CustomerId]  INT            NOT NULL,
    [FullName]    NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [Country]     CHAR (2)       NOT NULL
);
### write src/DWH/dim/Tables/DimDate.sql
CREATE TABLE [dim].[DimDate]
(
    [DateKey] INT  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [Date]    DATE NOT NULL,
    [Year]    INT  NOT NULL,
    [Month]   INT  NOT NULL
);
### write src/DWH/dim/Tables/DimProduct.sql
CREATE TABLE [dim].[DimProduct]
(
    [ProductKey] INT            IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [ProductId]  INT            NOT NULL,
    [Name]       NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [Category]   NVARCHAR (100) NULL
);
### write src/DWH/etl/Stored Procedures/usp_RunNightly.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [etl].[usp_RunNightly]
AS
BEGIN
    EXEC [dim].[usp_LoadDimCustomer];
    EXEC [fact].[usp_LoadFactSales];
    INSERT INTO [etl].[EtlLog] ([Step], [Logged]) VALUES ('nightly', SYSUTCDATETIME());
END
### write src/DWH/etl/Tables/EtlLog.sql
CREATE TABLE [etl].[EtlLog]
(
    [Id]      INT           IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [Step]    VARCHAR (50)  NOT NULL,
    [Logged]  DATETIME2 (0) NOT NULL
);
### write src/DWH/fact/Stored Procedures/usp_LoadFactSales.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [fact].[usp_LoadFactSales]
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [fact].[FactSales] ([OrderId], [CustomerKey], [ProductKey], [DateKey], [Revenue])
    SELECT o.[OrderId], c.[CustomerKey], 0, CONVERT(INT, FORMAT(o.[OrderDate], 'yyyyMMdd')), o.[TotalAmount]
    FROM [$(Staging)].[stg].[stg_Orders] AS o
    INNER JOIN [dim].[DimCustomer] AS c ON c.[CustomerId] = o.[CustomerId];
    UPDATE f SET f.[Revenue] = f.[Revenue] - inv.[Correction]
    FROM [fact].[FactSales] AS f
    INNER JOIN [$(ErpDb)].[dbo].[Invoices] AS inv ON inv.[OrderId] = f.[OrderId];
END
### write src/DWH/fact/Tables/FactSales.sql
CREATE TABLE [fact].[FactSales]
(
    [OrderId]     INT             NOT NULL,
    [CustomerKey] INT             NOT NULL,
    [ProductKey]  INT             NOT NULL,
    [DateKey]     INT             NOT NULL,
    [Revenue]     DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [FK_FactSales_DimCustomer] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerKey]) REFERENCES [dim].[DimCustomer] ([CustomerKey]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_FactSales_DimProduct] FOREIGN KEY ([ProductKey]) REFERENCES [dim].[DimProduct] ([ProductKey]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_FactSales_DimDate] FOREIGN KEY ([DateKey]) REFERENCES [dim].[DimDate] ([DateKey])
);
### write src/DWH/mart/Views/vw_SalesByMonth.sql
CREATE VIEW [mart].[vw_SalesByMonth]
AS
SELECT d.[Year], d.[Month], SUM(f.[Revenue]) AS [Revenue]
FROM [fact].[FactSales] AS f
INNER JOIN [dim].[DimDate] AS d ON d.[DateKey] = f.[DateKey]
GROUP BY d.[Year], d.[Month];

### write src/Staging/crm_stg/Stored Procedures/usp_LoadFromCrm.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [crm_stg].[usp_LoadFromCrm]
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [crm_stg].[stg_Contacts] ([CrmId], [Email], [Segment])
    SELECT Id, Email, Segment FROM OPENQUERY(CRM, 'SELECT Id, Email, Segment FROM Contact');
END
### write src/Staging/crm_stg/Tables/stg_Contacts.sql
CREATE TABLE [crm_stg].[stg_Contacts]
(
    [CrmId]   VARCHAR (18)   NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [Email]   NVARCHAR (256) NULL,
    [Segment] VARCHAR (20)   NULL
);
### write src/Staging/etl/Stored Procedures/usp_LogRun.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [etl].[usp_LogRun]
    @Process VARCHAR (50)
AS
    INSERT INTO [etl].[EtlRuns] ([Process], [StartedAt]) VALUES (@Process, SYSUTCDATETIME());
### write src/Staging/etl/Tables/EtlRuns.sql
CREATE TABLE [etl].[EtlRuns]
(
    [RunId]     INT           IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [Process]   VARCHAR (50)  NOT NULL,
    [StartedAt] DATETIME2 (0) NOT NULL
);
### write src/Staging/stg/Stored Procedures/usp_LoadFromSales.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [stg].[usp_LoadFromSales]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    TRUNCATE TABLE [stg].[stg_OrderItems];
    DELETE FROM [stg].[stg_Orders];
    INSERT INTO [stg].[stg_Orders] ([OrderId], [CustomerId], [OrderDate], [TotalAmount], [LoadedAt])
    SELECT [OrderId], [CustomerId], [OrderDate], [TotalAmount], SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM [$(Sales)].[sales].[Orders];
    INSERT INTO [stg].[stg_Customers] ([CustomerId], [FullName], [Country])
    SELECT [CustomerId], [FullName], [CountryCode] FROM [$(Sales)].[crm].[Customers];
    EXEC [etl].[usp_LogRun] @Process = 'LoadFromSales';
END
### write src/Staging/stg/Tables/stg_Customers.sql
CREATE TABLE [stg].[stg_Customers]
(
    [CustomerId] INT            NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [FullName]   NVARCHAR (200) NOT NULL,
    [Country]    CHAR (2)       NOT NULL
);
### write src/Staging/stg/Tables/stg_OrderItems.sql
CREATE TABLE [stg].[stg_OrderItems]
(
    [OrderId]   INT             NOT NULL,
    [LineNo]    SMALLINT        NOT NULL,
    [ProductId] INT             NOT NULL,
    [LineTotal] DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_stg_OrderItems] PRIMARY KEY ([OrderId], [LineNo]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_stg_OrderItems_Orders] FOREIGN KEY ([OrderId]) REFERENCES [stg].[stg_Orders] ([OrderId])
);

    [TotalAmount] DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [LoadedAt]    DATETIME2 (0)   NOT NULL
);

### write src/Sales/Security/rpt.sql
CREATE SCHEMA [rpt] AUTHORIZATION [dbo];
### write src/Sales/rpt/Stored Procedures/usp_DynamicPivot.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [rpt].[usp_DynamicPivot]
    @Columns NVARCHAR (MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @pivotSql NVARCHAR (MAX) = N'SELECT * FROM rpt.vw_SalesReport PIVOT (SUM(Revenue) FOR Product IN (' + @Columns + N')) AS p';
    EXEC (@pivotSql);
END
### write src/Sales/rpt/Stored Procedures/usp_MonthlyKpi.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [rpt].[usp_MonthlyKpi]
    @Year INT,
    @Month INT
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT SUM([Revenue]) AS [Revenue] FROM [rpt].[vw_SalesReport]
    WHERE YEAR([Day]) = @Year AND MONTH([Day]) = @Month;
END
### write src/Sales/rpt/Views/vw_LegacyKpi.sql
CREATE VIEW [rpt].[vw_LegacyKpi]
AS
SELECT [KpiName], [KpiValue] FROM [dbo].[KpiCache];
### write src/Sales/rpt/Views/vw_SalesReport.sql
CREATE VIEW [rpt].[vw_SalesReport]
AS
SELECT CAST(o.[OrderDate] AS DATE) AS [Day], p.[Name] AS [Product], SUM(i.[LineTotal]) AS [Revenue], o.[DiscountCode]
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS i ON i.[OrderId] = o.[OrderId]
INNER JOIN [cat].[Products] AS p ON p.[ProductId] = i.[ProductId]
GROUP BY CAST(o.[OrderDate] AS DATE), p.[Name], o.[DiscountCode];
### write src/Sales/rpt/Views/vw_TopCustomers.sql
CREATE VIEW [rpt].[vw_TopCustomers]
AS
SELECT TOP (100) c.[CustomerId], c.[FullName], SUM(o.[TotalAmount]) AS [Revenue]
FROM [crm].[Customers] AS c
INNER JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o ON o.[CustomerId] = c.[CustomerId]
GROUP BY c.[CustomerId], c.[FullName]
ORDER BY SUM(o.[TotalAmount]) DESC;

### write src/Sales/Security/pay.sql
CREATE SCHEMA [pay] AUTHORIZATION [dbo];
### write src/Sales/pay/Stored Procedures/usp_CapturePayment.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [pay].[usp_CapturePayment]
    @OrderId INT,
    @Amount DECIMAL (18, 2),
    @Provider VARCHAR (30)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO [pay].[Transactions] ([OrderId], [Amount], [CurrencyCode], [Provider], [Status])
    VALUES (@OrderId, @Amount, 'PLN', @Provider, 'CAPTURED');
    UPDATE [sales].[Orders] SET [StatusId] = 2 WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId;
END
### write src/Sales/pay/Tables/Refunds.sql
CREATE TABLE [pay].[Refunds]
(
    [RefundId]      BIGINT          IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [TransactionId] BIGINT          NOT NULL,
    [Amount]        DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [Reason]        NVARCHAR (200)  NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Refunds] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([RefundId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Refunds_Transactions] FOREIGN KEY ([TransactionId]) REFERENCES [pay].[Transactions] ([TransactionId])
);
### write src/Sales/pay/Tables/Transactions.sql
CREATE TABLE [pay].[Transactions]
(
    [TransactionId] BIGINT          IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [OrderId]       INT             NOT NULL,
    [Amount]        DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [CurrencyCode]  CHAR (3)        NOT NULL,
    [Provider]      VARCHAR (30)    NOT NULL,
    [Status]        VARCHAR (20)    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Transactions] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([TransactionId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Transactions_Orders] FOREIGN KEY ([OrderId]) REFERENCES [sales].[Orders] ([OrderId])
);

### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/Orders.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[Orders]
(
    [OrderId]      INT             IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [CustomerId]   INT             NOT NULL,
    [OrderDate]    DATETIME2 (0)   NOT NULL,
    [StatusId]     TINYINT         NOT NULL,
    [TotalAmount]  DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [DiscountCode] VARCHAR (20)    NULL,
    [CurrencyCode] CHAR (3)        CONSTRAINT [DF_Orders_CurrencyCode] DEFAULT ('PLN') NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy]    NVARCHAR (128)  CONSTRAINT [DF_Orders_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (suser_sname()) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Orders] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([OrderId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_Customers] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [crm].[Customers] ([CustomerId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_OrderStatus] FOREIGN KEY ([StatusId]) REFERENCES [sales].[OrderStatus] ([StatusId])
);
GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Orders_CustomerId_OrderDate]
    ON [sales].[Orders]([CustomerId] ASC, [OrderDate] ASC);
### commit 2026-07-02 aw Orders: add CurrencyCode
### write src/Sales/cat/Views/vw_Catalog.sql
CREATE VIEW [cat].[vw_Catalog]
AS
SELECT p.[ProductId], p.[Sku], p.[Name], c.[Name] AS [Category], pr.[Price], pr.[CurrencyCode]
FROM [cat].[Products] AS p
INNER JOIN [cat].[Categories] AS c ON c.[CategoryId] = p.[CategoryId]
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) x.[Price], x.[CurrencyCode] FROM [cat].[Prices] AS x WHERE x.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId] ORDER BY x.[ValidFrom] DESC) AS pr
WHERE p.[IsActive] = 1 AND c.[Name] IS NOT NULL;

### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_SearchOrders.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_SearchOrders]
    @Source SYSNAME,
    @From DATE,
    @To DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR (MAX) = N'SELECT o.OrderId, o.OrderDate FROM sales.' + QUOTENAME(@Source) + N' AS o WHERE o.OrderDate BETWEEN @From AND @To';
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql, N'@From date, @To date', @From, @To;
END

### write src/Sales/pay/Stored Procedures/usp_Refund.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [pay].[usp_Refund]
    @OrderId INT,
    @Reason NVARCHAR (200)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO [pay].[Refunds] ([TransactionId], [Amount], [Reason])
    SELECT t.[TransactionId], t.[Amount], @Reason FROM [pay].[PaymentTransactions] AS t WHERE t.[OrderId] = @OrderId;
END
### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_CancelOrder.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_CancelOrder]
    @OrderId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    UPDATE [sales].[Orders] SET [StatusId] = 9 WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId;
    EXEC [pay].[usp_Refund] @OrderId = @OrderId, @Reason = N'Anulowanie';
    DELETE FROM [inv].[Reservations] WHERE [OrderId] = @OrderId;
END
### commit 2026-09-26 kl Refunds on cancel
### write src/Sales/sales/Tables/Orders.sql
CREATE TABLE [sales].[Orders]
(
    [OrderId]      INT             IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [CustomerId]   INT             NOT NULL,
    [OrderDate]    DATETIME2 (0)   NOT NULL,
    [StatusId]     TINYINT         NOT NULL,
    [TotalAmount]  DECIMAL (18, 2) NOT NULL,
    [CurrencyCode] CHAR (3)        CONSTRAINT [DF_Orders_CurrencyCode] DEFAULT ('PLN') NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy]    NVARCHAR (128)  CONSTRAINT [DF_Orders_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (suser_sname()) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Orders] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([OrderId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_Customers] FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [crm].[Customers] ([CustomerId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Orders_OrderStatus] FOREIGN KEY ([StatusId]) REFERENCES [sales].[OrderStatus] ([StatusId])
);
GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Orders_CustomerId_OrderDate]
    ON [sales].[Orders]([CustomerId] ASC, [OrderDate] ASC);

### write src/Sales/sales/Stored Procedures/usp_CreateOrder.sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [sales].[usp_CreateOrder]
    @CustomerId INT,
    @Items [sales].[OrderItemList] READONLY,
    @CurrencyCode CHAR (3) = 'PLN',
    @OrderId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO [sales].[Orders] ([CustomerId], [OrderDate], [StatusId], [TotalAmount], [CurrencyCode])
    VALUES (@CustomerId, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 1, 0, @CurrencyCode);
    SET @OrderId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    INSERT INTO [sales].[OrderItems] ([OrderId], [LineNo], [ProductId], [Quantity], [UnitPrice])
    SELECT @OrderId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.[ProductId]), i.[ProductId], i.[Quantity], p.[Price]
    FROM @Items AS i
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) x.[Price] FROM [cat].[Prices] AS x WHERE x.[ProductId] = i.[ProductId] ORDER BY x.[ValidFrom] DESC) AS p;
    UPDATE o SET o.[TotalAmount] = [sales].[fn_OrderTotal](@OrderId)
    FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o WHERE o.[OrderId] = @OrderId;
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

### write src/Sales/inv/Tables/StockLevels.sql
CREATE TABLE [inv].[StockLevels]
(
    [ProductId]   INT NOT NULL,
    [WarehouseId] INT NOT NULL,
    [Qty]         INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_StockLevels] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ProductId] ASC, [WarehouseId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_StockLevels_Products] FOREIGN KEY ([ProductId]) REFERENCES [cat].[Products] ([ProductId]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_StockLevels_Warehouses] FOREIGN KEY ([WarehouseId]) REFERENCES [inv].[Warehouses] ([WarehouseId])
);
GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_StockLevels_ProductId_Warehouse]
    ON [inv].[StockLevels]([ProductId] ASC, [WarehouseId] ASC) INCLUDE([Qty]);
